summary: Turn IFRS S1 and S2 requirements into owned workflows, controls and evidence. Explore the practical implementation course.
lede: IFRS S1 and S2 implementation training helps finance, sustainability and assurance professionals build workable disclosure processes. They practise setting reporting boundaries, recording materiality judgments, clarifying governance responsibilities, assigning data owners, mapping evidence to disclosure requirements, checking climate metrics and designing controls, review workflows and phased readiness plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, govern, test or advise on sustainability-related financial disclosures and need to translate the IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 requirements into workable reporting processes.
outcomes: IFRS S1 and S2 Readiness Assessment
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 Implementation Scope
IFRS S2 Metrics and Emissions Records
IFRS S1 and S2 Data Controls
IFRS S1 and S2 Readiness Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with corporate financial reporting, sustainability reporting or risk and control processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use disclosure examples and spreadsheet-based records.
